title: PrecastConcreteFrameHollow
description: PrecastConcreteFrameHollow: Floor configuration of a hollow core slab supported on a precast concrete frame of primary and secondary beams.

Slab.description: Surface property defining the construction and thickness of the slab. HollowCore: Property for 2D analytical elements, made up of a fixed thickness slab of homogenous material, with a series of parallel holes through it in a particular direction.

SlabReinforcement.description: Reinforcement of the slab, defined either as an estimated density or as an explicit layout. Can be null if no slab reinforcement is to be accounted for. ISlabReinforcement: Base interface for the reinforcement definition of the slab in a floor configuration, for example estimated as a density (EstimateSlabReinforcement) or explicitly laid out (LayoutSlabReinforcement).

PrimaryBeam.description: Section of the primary beams spanning between columns in the local X direction. ConcreteSection: Concrete section to be used on Bars. Defined by a section profile. Note that all section constants are assuming an uncracked section and are disregarding reinforcement.

SecondaryBeam.description: Section of the secondary beams spanning between the primary beams in the local Y direction. ConcreteSection: Concrete section to be used on Bars. Defined by a section profile. Note that all section constants are assuming an uncracked section and are disregarding reinforcement.

BeamReinforcement.description: Reinforcement applied to the beams. Can be left null if more detailed reinforcement is applied to the ConcreteSections for Primary and Secondary beams. IBeamReinforcement: Base interface for the reinforcement definition of the beams in a floor configuration, for example EstimateBeamReinforcement.

NumSecondary.description: Number of secondary (infill) beams in a bay, counting the beam on one edge of the bay but not the one on the opposite edge. Set to zero for no secondary beams.

PrimaryBeamTopLevel.description: Distance from top of slab to top of primary beam. Set to slab thickness for slab on top but set to zero for within depth of slab. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

SecondaryBeamTopLevel.description: Distance from top of slab to top of secondary beam. Set to slab thickness for slab on top but set to zero for within depth of slab. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
